text: Entry Requirements 1. Nationality · Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens. · For applicants who originally held Chinese nationality and later acquired foreign nationality, CPU adheres to the provisions outlined in Announcement No. 12 (2020) issued by the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China. 2. Age Qualifications · Applicants must be 18–25 years old and have graduated from high school (or equivalent). · Applicants under 18 years of age as of September 1 of the enrollment year must submit an original notarized guardianship certificate issued by a notary public office in Nanjing. The guardian must be a permanent resident of Nanjing. · Applicants must possess good moral character, sound physical and mental health, and agree to abide by Chinese laws, regulations, and CPU’s rules and regulations. 3. Minimum Chinese language requirement: HSK4 and above (for Chinese-taught programs). 4. CSCA subjects requirements
